verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a GPU rental platform, but the evidence documents no first-party way to export a user's account data or files in open formats. Volume backups only restore onto another Lium node. The pricing CSV, public node feed and markdown docs are public platform data, not the user's own data. Copying files off a pod with root access would be a user-side workaround, not a product export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
